riskHeadline: Executive demand is outpacing approval capacity and creating avoidable delay.
frictionSignal: Review cycles bunch up around the same policy, trust, and legal checkpoints.
blockingIssue: Approvals still depend on too few shared reviewers and too many memo handoffs.

riskHeadline: The team is spending too much time repackaging evidence that should already be standardized.
frictionSignal: Answer packs, proof attachments, and buyer narratives still fork by deal instead of sharing one operating source.
blockingIssue: Evidence packaging standards are not yet consistent enough across trust, procurement, and diligence rooms.

riskHeadline: Regulated credibility is high, but execution still stalls between evidence creation and release-ready decisions.
frictionSignal: Validation and quality evidence live in too many adjacent flows with too much manual reconciliation.
blockingIssue: QA, CAPA, specimen, and GxP lanes still hand work across separate checkpoints instead of one narrower closure flow.

riskHeadline: Commercial opportunity exists, but change overhead is still too high for confident scaling.
frictionSignal: One control update still creates too many downstream review and coordination tasks.
blockingIssue: Merchant, KYC, and treasury changes are not yet isolated enough to prevent repeated regression checks.

riskHeadline: Work is getting done, but too many decisions still depend on informal ownership rather than visible accountability.
frictionSignal: Program proof, donor stewardship, and grant evidence still move through overlapping owners without one hard closer.
blockingIssue: Too many adjacent workstreams share responsibility without a single final owner per packet.

riskHeadline: The lane is interesting, but the toolchain is still too fragmented to justify heavier operating investment.
frictionSignal: One incident or override still forces operators to jump between too many views, logs, and narratives.
blockingIssue: Fleet, sensor, and override flows are not yet consolidated enough to keep response work continuous.
